tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products across the marketplaces Escrova can actually buy from today. Six sources are searchable: amazon, ebay, walmart, bestbuy, homedepot, wayfair, or "all". GET /api/products/search. No wallet and no signature. Send q, cat, or both; page and every selected filter are preserved together. A

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: The current fee schedule and delivery rates, so a total can be explained before anyone pays it. GET /api/config/fees. No wallet and no signature.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Current USD prices of the coins shown on Escrova. GET /api/prices. No wallet and no signature. Checkout on this deployment takes USDC only.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Returns the current Terms of Service and Privacy Policy version and document hash. These are the exact values accept_terms will record; they are read server-side and never taken from your request. GET /api/agent/legal/terms. No wallet and no signature.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Start a shopping task here instead of guessing search words. Returns the sixteen departments, each with the slug get_category takes and a picture. tools.description: Narrow towards a purchase without inventing keywords. One call returns children[] and childrenDeep[] with estimated counts, brands[] each with an engineParam you can pass straight back to search_products.engineParam, the shop's own facets[], aspectTiles[], siblings[], related[] and a deals[] rail.
